g.text: Dynamic padding in action — batch shapes vary across batches
inputs (8, 61) targets (8, 61) ← all 8 sequences pad to 61 tokens
inputs (8, 76) targets (8, 76) ← this batch's longest is 76 tokens
inputs (8, 73) targets (8, 73) ← this batch's longest is 73 tokens
inputs (8, ?) targets (8, ?) ← ? depends on longest in that specific batch
First dim always = 8 (batch_size). Second dim varies — dynamic padding is working.
